messages:
joel park: Hey all! I'm Joel Park — starting today as ML Infra Engineer. Excited to be here and pair with Samir this week. Quick Q: who should I ping for Dedicated environment access? Also, my APM alert emails aren't showing up yet. :wave:

mikaela: Welcome Joel!! I'm Mikaela from People Ops :tada:. Congrats and glad to have you. I added you to the #new-hires-okta group. Check onboarding playbook: https://redwood.company/onboarding/new-hire-playbook — it has the access matrix. If you hit any blockers ping me or DM @samir.

samir: Hey Joel — welcome! I'll start the Dedicated access request. Can you DM me your employee id (or paste here if you're comfortable)? For VPN and bastion access run:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_id_rsa joel@bastion.redwood.internal
``` 
I'll follow up on the APM email whitelist too.

devops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4902 — provisioning for joel. Status: pending approvals.

anya: hi Joel, i'm Anya (infra). Fun fact: I once benchmarked the same model on 3 different GPUs in one afternoon. :grin: If you want a quick tour of the dev rig + perf dashboard, ping me and we can set 30m.

joel park: Thanks everyone — sending my employee id via DM now @samir. Anya, would love the tour this afternoon if that works. Mikaela, appreciate the add. Quick note: my macbook's enrolled but Docker isn't starting (error: 'Cannot allocate memory'). Any standard fix?

samir: For Docker on mac try resetting resources in Docker Desktop prefs (CPU 4, Memory 8GB) and restart. If that doesn't help, paste the error log here and I'll escalate.

mikaela: Also FYI, there's a welcome lunch today at 12:30 in the kitchen — come by if you're on-site! :salad:

joel park: I'll try the Docker tweak now and join lunch if I can. Thanks all :raised_hands:
